summary.oneLiner: Nazara fundamentally reshaped its profile in FY26 with gaming EBITDA contribution jumping to 90% and margins doubling to 19.5% in Q4, driven by operational leverage from Centers of Excellence and the pending consolidation of Bluetile which promises to double the platform's EBITDA base. The strategic pivot involves divesting non-core assets (NODWIN, Sportskeeda, AdTech) to redeploy capital into high-margin global gaming IPs while leveraging AI for content scaling and user acquisition efficiency.

one-line thesis: Nazara fundamentally reshaped its profile in FY26 with gaming EBITDA contribution jumping to 90% and margins doubling to 19.5% in Q4, driven by operational leverage from Centers of Excellence and the pending consolidation of Bluetile which promises to double the platform's EBITDA base. The strategic pivot involves divesting non-core assets (NODWIN, Sportskeeda, AdTech) to redeploy capital into high-margin global gaming IPs while leveraging AI for content scaling and user acquisition efficiency.
financial scorecard: Revenue INR 1,829cr (+13% YoY); EBITDA INR 255cr (+66% YoY, 13.9% margin); Q4 Revenue INR 398cr, EBITDA INR 78cr (19.5% margin); PAT impacted by INR 31cr one-off gain on Rusk Media investment and INR 50cr goodwill write-off at associate NODWIN; Gaming segment EBITDA +157% YoY to INR 265cr (24.7% margin); No disclosed order book (service/IP model).
guidance: FY27 expected to show accelerated organic growth and margin expansion driven by COE output and AI implementation; Bluetile consolidation from Q1FY27 expected to at least double consolidated EBITDA base; No specific numerical revenue guidance provided but 'bullish' on strong financial performance.
order book & pipeline: N/A (IP-driven pipeline); PC/Console launching 6+ new titles in FY27 including 'Sovereign Tower' and 'Dragon Shelter'; Fusebox expanding 'Big Brother' to 3 seasons and launching 'Traitors' in FY27; Kiddopia launching adjacent category apps.
segment / subsidiary detail: Gaming: Rev INR 1,072cr (+107% YoY), EBITDA INR 265cr (+157% YoY). Mobile: Rev INR 713cr (+38% YoY). PC/Console: Rev INR 261cr (flat), EBITDA INR 101cr (39% margin). Offline: Rev INR 99cr, EBITDA INR 27cr (profitable). AdTech: Rev/EBITDA +32% YoY but sequential decline in Q4 due to strategic pivot to product-led DSP. NODWIN (Associate): Turned profitable (INR 21cr EBITDA) despite INR 50cr goodwill write-off.
growth verticals / optionality: Bluetile acquisition (pending Spanish FDI approval, expected close in 3-4 weeks) adds INR 1,460cr revenue/INR 254cr EBITDA scale; AI-driven content generation reducing cost per unit; Potential divestment of NODWIN, Sportskeeda, and AdTech to unlock value; Expansion of Fusebox narrative IPs beyond 'Love Island'.
margins & cost dynamics: Q4 EBITDA margin reached 19.5% (up from ~10% YoY); Gaming segment margin 24.7%; PC/Console margin 39%; Margin expansion drivers include AI efficiency, platform synergies via Centers of Excellence, and potential reduction in platform fees (Apple/Google) over time; Depreciation down 24% QoQ partly due to NODWIN deconsolidation.
capex / expansion: Focus on inorganic growth (M&A) and tech investment (AI/Data); Specific capex number not disclosed but development spend increasing for new PC/Console titles; Reinvestment in AdTech product-led growth (Vizibl DSP).
capital allocation: Strategy to divest non-core businesses (NODWIN, Sportskeeda, AdTech) and redeploy proceeds into core high-margin gaming; NODWIN planning independent fundraising of $100-200mn (primary/secondary) and IPO; Organic reinvestment in IP expansion and COE capabilities.
risks & watch-items: Regulatory delay in Bluetile acquisition (Spanish FDI); Google Core update impact on Sportskeeda traffic (revenue down 38% FY26); Seasonality in Fusebox titles; Integration risks with Bluetile; High amortization/write-offs in associates (NODWIN).
management quality / tone: Highly confident and transformational; Emphasis on 'pivotal year', 'fundamental change', and 'operating leverage compounding'; Clear strategic clarity on focusing purely on gaming while monetizing non-core assets.
non-obvious takeaways: The INR 31cr 'other income' was a mark-to-market gain on Rusk Media investment, not cash flow; NODWIN's operational profitability is masked by a one-time INR 50cr goodwill write-off related to NH7 Weekender; AdTech revenue decline is a conscious strategic exit from low-margin traditional agency work to high-margin product-led DSP, not market loss.
challenges → beneficiaries & losers:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Need for scalable casual gaming exposure with AI integration | Nazara Technologies Ltd | beneficiary | High | Direct beneficiary of Bluetile consolidation doubling EBITDA base and AI-driven margin expansion across portfolio. |
| Google algorithm updates reducing ad revenue for digital media publishers | Sportskeeda (Internal Asset) | loser | Med | Revenue declined 38% in FY26 due to Google Core updates; management focusing on cost optimization rather than revenue recovery. |
| Goodwill impairment and high amortization masking operational gains | NODWIN Gaming | loser | Low | Operational turnaround to INR 21cr EBITDA overshadowed by INR 50cr write-off; potential divestment candidate. |

themes.title: Digital platforms, SaaS, payments & cybersecurity
themes.need: Digital-public-infrastructure scale, enterprise SaaS and a compliance/security upcycle drive a distinct platform cohort. PINELABS/NPST/CMSINFO on payments; AURIONPRO/NEWGEN/NUCLEUS/ROUTE/TANLA on banking/CPaaS software; EMUDHRA/META(544441)/AURIONPRO on digital-identity & cybersecurity; CAPILLARY/MAPMYINDIA/NAZARA on SaaS/geospatial/gaming. Q1FY27 anchored the payments leg: PAYTM's GMV grew 31% YoY (accelerating 23% -> 27% -> 31%) with merchant payments about 80% of the financial-services mix and 25-30 lakh device additions a year on a distribution-only lending model (no book, no FLDG); MOBIKWIK posted payments GMV of INR 52,400cr (+58% YoY), a 13th consecutive record quarter and India's largest wallet by GTV at ~20% share, against only ~INR 3,200cr of digital-credit GMV. OFSS adds the banking-software annuity, with RPO +17% YoY versus revenue +7% and licence-and-cloud revenue +13% at a 44% operating margin.
themes.driver: Deal/ARR additions; festive digital-payments TPV; merchant-device additions; RBI/regulatory compliance-driven security spend.

themes.title: Media, entertainment & out-of-home advertising
themes.need: Digital-content, music-IP licensing and an advertising-recovery cycle underpin media - TIPSMUSIC on music IP; ZEEL/ENIL/RADIOCITY/BTML on broadcast/content; HTMEDIA/DBCORP/HMVL on print + digital; SIGNPOST/BRIGHT-tier and UFO on OOH/cinema. Ad-spend revival is the near-term swing factor.
themes.driver: Festive ad-spend recovery; music-licensing/streaming monetization; OOH inventory uptake.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Framed as an evolution "from an entrepreneurial gaming company into a significantly larger and increasingly global gaming platform", with shared capabilities across user acquisition, data, product and growth "translating into stronger performance across the gaming portfolio".
- Gaming is the core: Q1FY27 gaming revenue of INR 275 Cr grew 14% YoY at a 19.5% EBITDA margin and "all gaming businesses remained EBITDA-positive".
- Post-consolidation the mix tilts decisively to gaming - "gaming represents approximately 84% of illustrative consolidated revenue" (deck's own illustrative arithmetic aggregation of Q1FY27 figures, expressly "not a forecast or pro forma financial statement").
- Bluetile is presented as an "AI-Powered Game Production Platform" where "One production platform behind every game" runs Block Blitz, Sort Journey, Hole Rush, Solitaire "...and 23 more live titles, all running on the same core".
- Fusebox "Ranks #1 in Free Apps and #5 in Top Grossing Apps Category in the US".

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Leadership] Raymond A. Stauffer - Founder and former CEO of Bluetile and BestPlay - is appointed Chief Executive Officer of Nazara Technologies effective 1 September 2026, subject to relevant regulatory approvals, leading day-to-day Group operations, integration and shared operating capabilities; Nitish Mittersain continues as Founder and Managing Director shaping long-term strategy, portfolio direction and key relationships. Maxime Loppin is appointed CEO of Bluetile and BestPlay.
- [Deconsolidation] NODWIN has been deconsolidated from August 2025, which is why reported consolidated revenue declined 14% YoY while "Excluding NODWIN, comparable consolidated revenue grew approximately 9% YoY"; NODWIN now flows through share of loss from associates.
- [Reported loss] Q1FY27 reported PAT was a loss of INR 82 crore, which the deck attributes largely to share of loss from associates (INR 62 crore) and an impairment loss (INR 22 crore).
- [IPO readiness] NODWIN is described as having "Youth Media Strategy and IPO Readiness in Full Flow", with organic growth "poised to be at 30% for this FY"; its focus is stated as "Global South with offices across the world. Global North as revenue. Global South as execution".
- [Retention] NODWIN's ESOP plan is offered to all employees, "resulting in to sub-5% attrition", and founder retention post-earnouts has had "ZERO attritions"; NODWIN has also moved NH7 to a license model for India ("the license fee will go straight to the bottom line") and ended the MG deals for Comic Con in favour of direct ticket sales.
